budgets.scope: solver + exact independent replay + attempt selection; same whole-task deadline for every method
budgets.timeout: required Unix SIGALRM on main thread; BaseException + parent subprocess watchdog; no cooperative fallback

holdout.failures: Unsupported exponents/spaces, invalid responses, timeout and loose certificates remain in denominators and full raw results
holdout.fixed_minus_quarter: regression only, never a new holdout
holdout.prior_overlap: Keep the identical sampler without rejection/resampling. Label any exact task repeated from prior public validation, old six or previous fourteen as regression; label duplicates within this draw. Only unique nonoverlapping cases count as independent new instances. All fourteen remain in costs and full success denominators.
holdout.sampler: SHA256(seed || 8-byte counter), modulo each predeclared list; no success/stability/support rejection or resampling

reliability: wrong original function, wrong space, impossible bound and status-only certificate rejected; reliability failure blocks improvement claim
replay: frozen v317 verification.verify_any with original function, conclusion kind, space and tolerance bound; independent constant eigenvalue inclusion; never trust returned status flags

reward_rules.accuracy: An additional robust heldout success over the strongest robust-success baseline, without lost successes or reliability failure, supports a limited within-family accuracy benefit.
reward_rules.incremental_first_release: Against first_release require no robust-success losses, no reliability regression, and both median AND five-session total full wall/CPU ratios <=1.0; no 20% compounding hurdle.
reward_rules.independent_subset: Report truly new unique instances separately, including successes and summed online wall/CPU per repeat. Whole-session initialization and output costs cannot be attributed to individual cases and remain whole-session only.
reward_rules.model_claims: actual model input/output/reasoning tokens, model identity, monetary cost and 30-min/8-hour comparison unknown; characters/bytes are not token proxies
reward_rules.no_aggregate: Report accuracy, reliability, runtime, automation, support, interaction and usability separately; no aggregate reward hides regressions.
reward_rules.old_six_cold_regression: On the original six public regression tasks require no robust-success loss against frozen_v317 and both median AND five-session total full wall/CPU ratios <=1.0, with all five raw values retained. No rounding or timing tolerance may turn a failure into pass.
reward_rules.resources: The long-term 80-iteration runtime gate requires equal robust successes, no per-case success loss and >=20% median full-session wall and CPU reduction against each applicable original baseline: old_default, fixed_increasing, validation_selected_fixed, frozen_v317. first_release is an incremental safety reference and is not a new >=20% hurdle. Validation preparation is charged to its selected baseline once; online-only results remain separate.

selection: 5 independent cold sessions/configuration on all 13 validation cases; maximize total budget-valid successes, then replay-valid certificates, then smallest predeclared configuration; never timing or per-task oracle
session_design: new subprocess per method/repetition; six methods rotated by repetition, five repeats; same task order rotated by repetition; session-local caches allowed, no cache across sessions; all imports/constructor setup and first-use lazy imports charged; exactly one release module root per process, independently checked
statistics: report 5 raw session totals, median/min/max; paired wins and losses against every baseline, per-case successes and 5/5 robust successes, family and scope breakdown; repeats are not independent mathematical tasks; small-sample timings descriptive
